TIDE aims at physical and mental care through integrating sleep, meditation, relax, and focus into an app. Inspired by traveling, nature, and meditation, we have been providing massive audios including natural soundscapes and mindfulness practices. … #Suitable for# … #Features# … #AWARDS# … (price and “free trail” at the end)

After — how you use it, then price from the live IAP copy

Tide is rain, ocean, or a 25-minute timer. Open a sound and sleep. Or start the timer and work until it rings. Breathing is there when you stall. Same app for night and the next sit-down. SLEEP • Nature scenes: rain, ocean, thunder, and more • Sleep and nap modes, plus a light wake-up • Sleep analysis if you turn it on • Sleep stories when white noise is not enough FOCUS • 25-minute blocks, custom lengths, or an open timer • Immersive mode so the phone stays out of the way • Mix your own music with a nature scene BREATHE • Balanced breathing • 4-7-8 when you want to sleep PRICE Free to start. Tide Plus $11.99 / month or $59.99 / year on the US listing fetched 2026-08-22. Other SKUs sit in the IAP list (including a $54.99 year). Cancel in Apple ID settings.

Why these changes

  • Keep the brand in the 30-character name; move category words to the subtitle
  • Fix the missing space in “Meditation,Breath”
  • Lead with rain / 25 minutes, not “physical and mental care” or award counts
  • Put the live Plus prices in promo + screenshot line 5 — no invented SKUs
  • Do not invent reviews or promise ranking
